issue.title: sase-research-artifacts CHANGELOG.md has a 404 compare link and a stray trailing heading
issue.description: Discovered by sase-pt.land (2026-08-18) while landing epic sase-pt, which cut the first release of sase-research-artifacts as v0.2.0. Release-please's staged CHANGELOG.md was accepted as-is under plan option A (accept v0.2.0 as the first release rather than force v0.1.0) so it would not block the release; the cosmetic issues were deliberately deferred rather than fixed. Not caused by sase-pt's own actions -- release-please generated the changelog content itself from repo history.

task_type_fields.impact: Cosmetic only -- does not block releases or installs. Anyone following the compare link from the changelog or the GitHub release notes hits a 404; the trailing heading is dead weight at end of file.
task_type_fields.location: sase-research-artifacts CHANGELOG.md (repo sase-org/sase-research-artifacts, open via 'sase repo open sase-research-artifacts')
task_type_fields.repro: Open CHANGELOG.md on master (current HEAD 253aa62). The '## [0.2.0](...)' heading links to https://github.com/sase-org/sase-research-artifacts/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0, which 404s because no v0.1.0 tag was ever created (v0.2.0 is the repo's first release). The file also ends with a stray trailing '## Changelog' heading with no content under it.
